headline: Key Dependencies for FastAPI Class
what_breaks: fastapi/routing.py — depends on BaseRoute from FastAPI
why: The FastAPI class is the main entry point for creating FastAPI applications, making it crucial for the framework's functionality. Changes to this class can impact routing, exception handling, and middleware integration across multiple files.
checklist: Review changes to the FastAPI class constructor and its parameters.
Check for modifications in telemetry handling and debug options.
Ensure compatibility with routes defined in fastapi/routing.py.
Verify interactions with exception handlers in fastapi/exception_handlers.py.
